notes.title: The project is launched!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42009956/a09413a0eefdd331bc862cd7ca8772a7030c8965.png[/img]

Good morning all !

We are pleased to present the first RPG from Bunkaland Studio. Her name ? JAMAL AND MEHDI: The Quest for the iencli. The game is a turn-based Urban RPG set in the universe of the JAMAL AND MEHDI animated series.

Self-taught, the production of this game is both a dream for us, but also a challenge! It is not easy these days to launch a new kind of project.

In the meantime, you will be able to follow the progress of the project here. Do not hesitate to talk about it around you. The movement is launched!

https://youtu.be/5vMqcakpVpI
